entries.subject: Anthe nominal unresolved-size sphere
entries.finding: The NASA/JPL nominal 0.5 km radius supplies an explicitly approximate sphere and missing-data grid. The 1 km diameter is an uncertain size estimate, not a measured spherical outline; Anthe’s shape remains unresolved.

entries.subject: Cassini OPUS Anthe candidates
entries.finding: The finest inspected candidate is about 0.714 km per pixel, only roughly 1.4 pixels across the nominal diameter, so it cannot supply a surface map.
entries.revisitWhen: A body-resolved observation with adequate native pixels and registered geometry can be assessed.

entries.subject: PDS Saturn shape release for Anthe
entries.finding: No body-specific deliverable was qualified in the reviewed release.
entries.revisitWhen: A released Anthe shape with usable provenance and frame can replace the nominal sphere.

entries.subject: Anthe terrain, colour and composition routes
entries.finding: No qualified DEM, geology or mapped composition product was identified; integrated photometry is not spatial data.
entries.revisitWhen: A body-specific spatial product can support a lens.
